verdict.summary: The round-2 diff remains correct and complete. `native_summary_spoke` centralizes the exact validity predicate used by native blocker counting and drift detection, excluding booleans and malformed/absent summaries. `open_blocker_count` preserves the existing fail-closed maximum while warning only when a well-formed native count differs from the validated open-marker count. The added self-tests exercise native-only and marker-only disagreement, agreement, closed markers, absent and malformed summaries, single-warning behavior, and unchanged dispatch counts; none is vacuous. No correctness, soundness, security, or injection issue is apparent. Compared with round 1, there are still no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
